metadata.definition: Includes exact artist credit strings as given in archive, de-duplicated case-insensitively and by whitespace. Combined collaborations remain intact. Artist identity IDs retained when present, but homonyms may require manual verification.
metadata.priority: Tier 1 high play count/recent listening/high rating; tier 2 moderate engagement; tier 3 low engagement or library-only. All tiers must be monitored.
metadata.warning: Snapshot of 2026-10-24; future new artists are not automatically added without an updated export or connected listening source.
